seed: Objects of type `block` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [] show mixed outcomes: no_change x26, tags x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Ring+beam move vertically by 6 carrying on-beam blocks, pushing blocks hit (push chain); cancelled if a block would leave the colour-4 field.
A4/A3 extend/retract beam by 6; any block at the tip (x==end-5) hooks all fully-on-beam blocks to follow the tip; unhooked extend pushes swept blocks.
Block A3 tags x1 = hooked next block with only collected blocks on the beam becomes collected; the 26 no_change = unhooked retracts. Click position plays no role (clicks are no-ops).
Off-beam collected blocks revert; HUD bar row fills (n-1)//3 per non-click action, legend icon centre 0 when collected.
Unconfirmed: bar phase is hidden (continuity-gated, fallback from bar length); hook rule for multiple tip blocks seen only once.
